author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical mail-client propagation (JMAP-tjvm.16). Per workspace canonical-template propagation rule, #[non_exhaustive] must land on canonical mail-client's params structs first (EmailGetParams, EmailCopyParams, MailboxSetParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams, EmailImportInput, EmailParseParams), then propagate to all 7 extension-client siblings in one pass. Adding #[non_exhaustive] to MetadataChangesParams alone would put metadata-client AHEAD of canonical, which is the inverse of the propagation rule. Will become unblocked when JMAP-tjvm.16 closes.
